text:
jenna_support: heads-up — Acme reported that after a customer-initiated refund/chargeback the account dropped into a negative credit state and their API calls started failing with a billing error. Can someone take a look? :frowning:

mike_billing: on it. do we have the chargeback txn id or invoice? I can pull logs from Stripe.

jenna_support: txn id is cb_1KqX9Lxyz, invoice inv_20260310_744. customer said they had ~$120 promotional credits applied from trial + a $50 promo code last month.

sam_engineer: quick note — the service responds with 402 currently when balance < 0. sample error from their logs:
```
{"error":"payment_required","code":402,"message":"negative balance: credits_clawed_back"}
```

sam_engineer: looking at request metadata the app key is for org: acme-inc (org_id: org_231). requests are being blocked at auth/billing check before model selection.

mike_billing: stripe shows a chargeback on the card for payment intent pi_3KqX... on 2026-03-10. We automatically reversed the $80 settled payment. That triggered our credit clawback rule which removed promotional credits tied to that payment, leaving the account -$50.

tony_finance: ugh — clawback logic should only reclaim credits that were granted specifically as a refund-to-credit replacement for that charge. Promo/free-trial credits must not be clawed. Looks like the rule matched any credit with source=invoice. will escalate.

jenna_support: customer-facing ask: they want their API restored asap; said they didn't request the chargeback (fraud suspected). can we temporarily unblock?

sam_engineer: we can bypass billing gate for their org as a short-term fix. would need a manual flag flip on the billing service or a temporary override in the auth proxy. low-risk for a few hours.

mike_billing: i can re-run the clawback logic in dry-run and confirm which credits were removed. tagging billing-bot to dump the credit history for org_231.

billing-bot: credit-history dump for org_231 attached.
```
- 2026-02-01: trial_credit $100 (source: trial)
- 2026-02-20: promo_code REPO50 $50 (source: promo)
- 2026-03-05: invoice_987 paid $80 (settled)
- 2026-03-10: chargeback reversed payment $80 => clawback triggered: removed invoice-linked credit $80
```

mike_billing: that's the issue — our engine tied the invoice payment to a generic 'invoice-linked credit' of $80 and removed it, then applied clawback that cascaded and made the account negative because promo/trial credits didn't cover the reversion.

tony_finance: action items: 1) manual credit to bring balance to >=0 so API works, 2) patch clawback rules to exclude promo/trial credits, 3) post-mortem + customer communication. will own (2) and (3).

jenna_support: can someone do (1) right now? customer is blocked in prod.

mike_billing: i can apply a manual one-time adjustment of $80 (payment_hold_recovery) to offset the clawback. doing it now.

billing-bot: manual adjustment +80 applied to org_231 by mike_billing at 2026-03-10T15:12:03Z. new balance: 0

sam_engineer: confirmed — API calls returning 200 for a few test requests now. putting a temporary bypass flag (billing_override=true) for 3h in prod until finance patch.

jenna_support: passing to the customer: "we've applied a temporary credit and restored service while we correct the clawback rules. you'll get a follow-up from finance." they replied :relieved:

mike_billing: creating billing ticket BILL-5423 to track the root cause + reconciliation with Stripe. assigning to tony_finance. also QoS: check other accounts with similar patterns.

tony_finance: noted. i will patch clawback predicate to ignore credits where credit.source in ["promo","trial"], add integration tests, and schedule a deploy tomorrow morning. will also reconcile with the payments team to confirm the chargeback status.

sam_engineer: devops note — if we change clawback semantics we should add a migration that flags past clawbacks that may need manual review. otherwise historical negatives won't auto-fix.

jenna_support: thanks team. i'll keep the thread open until finance confirms deploy and customer reply. recorded timeline for postmortem.

mike_billing: reaction :eyes:

tony_finance: i'll follow up in BILL-5423 with timeline and customer email draft.

jenna_support: resolved for now, leaving open for postmortem. :thumbsup:
